name: comment
description: A message an operator wrote in an incident thread (often Japanese), with the incident title for context.

intent.instructions: What is the operator doing with this message?

criteria.label: saying the alert was right, wrong, or had the wrong severity or team
criteria.known_issue: declaring something a known or accepted issue that should not alert
criteria.fact: stating a fact about the network or environment
criteria.instruction: asking for more investigation or a specific check
criteria.resolution: saying what the cause was or how it was fixed

needs_action_now.instructions: Does the message ask the bot to do something right now?
